description: This file defines extension methods for working with sets and collections within the Orleans project. It provides utility functions for converting enumerables to sets, string representations of enumerables, and dictionary value management.

classes.name: SetExtensions
classes.description: A static internal class providing extension methods for collections, including conversion to HashSet, string representation of collections, and dictionary value retrieval or addition.

methods.name: ToSet
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable to a HashSet of the specified type, supporting type inference.

methods.name: ToStrings
methods.description: Creates a string representation of an IEnumerable, concatenating elements with a separator, optionally using a custom ToString function.

methods.name: GetValueOrAddNew
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key in a dictionary or adds a new default instance if the key does not exist.
